name: Second Read: draft a support reply

parameters.content:
## Second Read in n8n
POST a support message to this webhook as JSON: {"text": "..."}.
It asks Second Read for a checked draft and returns it.
Only a reply the fresh checker passed, word for word, comes back as a plain draft. Everything else (escalate, no answer, blocked, a composed reply, not yet checked) goes to a person, with the hand-over note when there is one. The note says plainly when a draft must not be sent.

Second Read only reads. Nothing here sends a reply or changes an account: a person sends the draft.

Change the URL in **Ask Second Read** to wherever Second Read runs. 127.0.0.1:5610 works when n8n runs on the same computer. (Use 127.0.0.1, not localhost: newer n8n looks up localhost as ::1 and cannot reach Second Read.)
